incident-bot: Pager — SEV3: embedder-kvcache evictions spike on prod-embedder-01. Error rate 8% over 6m. Page to #incidents. oncall @sara please ack. https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/321
sara: Acked, I'm on it. Switching to mitigation mode. Setting routing to fail-open for embedder model to reduce tail latency.
mike: Noted. If you want a quick rollback to quantized variant, I can shift traffic to embedder-v2-q8. Need ~15m to validate and flip.
sara: Applying quick config: `kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.92` on prod-embedder-01. Rolling now.
anya: Customer impact: 12 customers show >=10% embedding latency increase, 3 reporting timeouts. Notified account teams and TSEs.
sara: Metrics: error rate down to 2% after threshold change, tail latency still elevated for seq>1024. Continuing observation.
kim: Handoff note — I'm taking oncall in 30m. Current mitigations: TTL bump, routing fallback, temp q8 variant warm-up. Logs uploaded: `/incidents/2400123456/logs` :thumbsup:
luis: I'll take overnight. Need to ensure post-incident follow-ups: postmortem, remediation tickets, customer comms.
mike: For kvcache capacity increase — dev work is M (2w). If infra slot procurement required, plus2w (so L). I'll scope dev tasks as M and call infra separately.
sara: Action list I'm creating now (tracker RED-INC-2400123456):
- A1: Increase kvcache soft limits + autoscale (owner: mike) size: M, est: 2w
- A2: Graceful eviction/backpressure path (owner: sara) size: S, est: 3d
- A3: Customer-facing summary + outreach (owner: anya) size: S, est: 1d
- A4: CI regression for long-seq eviction scenario (owner: kim) size: M, est: 1w
Please add any missing details in the ticket.
elaine: Product note — because multiple enterprise customers affected, mark A1 as P0 for this quarter and tie to Q4 reliability OKR. Recommend we scope partial rollout for early wins.
sara: Proposed postmortem: Wed 09:30 PT. Calendar invite posted: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/pm-2400123456 — @elaine @mike pls confirm availability.
anya: I'll draft the customer note post-PM and share in #customer-comms channel.
sara: Ok. Creating remediation roadmap items and tagging into next sprint board. Owners, please add estimates/PR reviewers to RED-INC-2400123456 before EOD tomorrow. Closing live thread, will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
